<section id="changelog">
<h1>Changelog</h1>
<blockquote>
<div><p><strong>Generated by releaseledger.</strong> Manual edits may be overwritten. Update releaseledger entries and rebuild this file instead.</p>
</div></blockquote>
<p>All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.</p>
<p>The format is based on <a class="reference external" href="https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/">Keep a Changelog</a>, and this project adheres to <a class="reference external" href="https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html">Semantic Versioning</a>.</p>
<section id="v0-5-1-2026-08-02">
<h2>[v0.5.1] - 2026-08-02</h2>
<section id="added">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added booktx translate store-status for canonical backend, source-hash, transaction, doctor, and legacy-copy visibility</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="changed">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Promoted the v3 translation store to the default for newly created profiles</p></li>
<li><p>Existing profiles continue using their detected backend and are never auto-migrated; explicit v2 creation, v2-to-v3 migration, backup, and rollback remain available</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="v0-5-0-2026-07-15">
<h2>[v0.5.0] - 2026-07-15</h2>
<section id="id1">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added a v3 translation store with a backend-neutral repository, a store doctor, and a crash-safe commit journal</p></li>
<li><p>Added a v3 store migration flow with plan, backup, parity, rollback, and a stale-lock policy gate</p></li>
<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">booktx</span> <span class="pre">translate</span> <span class="pre">lint-block</span></code>, a per-task agent brief, and a shared block-protocol module</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id2">
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Changed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">booktx</span> <span class="pre">translate</span> <span class="pre">migrate-store</span></code> to accept <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--to</span></code>, JSON output, custom backup, and a stale-lock policy</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="fixed">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">write_text_atomic</span></code> to preserve newlines on Windows and updated the subprocess test to use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sysconfig</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Fixed v3 store lock acquisition to probe liveness on Windows and surface a clear stale-lock repair error</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="v0-3-1-2026-06-30">
<h2>[v0.3.1] - 2026-06-30</h2>
<section id="id3">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added agents write, status, and clean commands to generate per-harness AGENTS.md files and remove only booktx-generated files</p></li>
<li><p>Added context export-pack and import-pack commands for sharing series-wide policy (style, global rules, glossary, approved answers) across book profiles</p></li>
<li><p>Added EPUB output target-language metadata and a deterministic best-effort hyphenation stylesheet configurable via the [epub_output] hyphenation policy</p></li>
<li><p>Added booktx chapters detection with –audit comparing the EPUB table of contents against extracted chapter spans and the chapter map</p></li>
<li><p>Added review configure, rerun, deactivate, and revise-record commands plus bounded multi-pass review tasks, a qa-scan command, and EPUB output inspection</p></li>
<li><p>Added context mandate-term and audit-term with active-only validation by default and improved glossary matching for terminology correction</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id4">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed translation validation to detect quotation mismatches in translated targets</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="v0-3-0-2026-06-26">
<h2>[v0.3.0] - 2026-06-26</h2>
<section id="id5">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added pass-through validation profile for custom project workflows</p></li>
<li><p>Added isolated profile-root mode with independent state management per workspace</p></li>
<li><p>Added user-approval workflow for context generation</p></li>
<li><p>Improved inline XHTML fragment handling with EPUB validation</p></li>
<li><p>Added translated content review system with acceptance workflow</p></li>
<li><p>Added large chapter workflow support with preflight validation</p></li>
<li><p>Added system hardening and bug fixes across CLI and task workflows</p></li>
<li><p>Improved check and review workflow with enhanced validation</p></li>
<li><p>Added export-index command for profile-local editor QA indexes</p></li>
<li><p>Improved context change CLI commands and agent skill instructions</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id6">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed unit test coverage across acceptance, CLI, and translation modules</p></li>
</ul>
<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
</section>
</section>
<section id="v0-2-0-2026-06-24">
<h2>[v0.2.0] - 2026-06-24</h2>
<section id="id7">
<h3>Added</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Added profile-based multi-language support with separate translation state per language</p></li>
<li><p>Added translation versioning with nested version tracks and improved part addressing via record refs</p></li>
<li><p>Added bounded multi-chapter run management with resumable task creation</p></li>
<li><p>Added chapter note context handling that excludes chapter-specific notes from context build hash</p></li>
<li><p>Added context markdown drift detection and safe overwrite guards for context.md</p></li>
<li><p>Added schema version for chunks with automatic rechunking and improved identity command</p></li>
<li><p>Added acceptance and submission system with submission resolution and progress tracking</p></li>
<li><p>Added profile migration tooling and identity module for resolving project state across layouts</p></li>
<li><p>Added translate CLI commands with improved agent skill instructions</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="id8">
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Fixed unit test failures in CLI context and epub IO tests</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed translation run model rebuild and agent status resolution</p></li>
</ul>

    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
